collection.methodology: Every descendant in the NARA Catalog hierarchy was enumerated. All file-unit titles, series, local identifiers, access status, container identifiers, and online-object metadata were retained in the full ledger. Transparent title rules identify foreign-economic review rows; all online PDFs were separately screened through NARA extracted text for opening-marker fields and high-level document signals. Only candidates with a source-supported working date enter the volume chronology.
